EVM_PRIVATE_KEY.description: Private key of a wallet with USDC on Base mainnet. Used for automatic x402 micropayments.

SPRAAY_GATEWAY_URL.description: Spraay x402 Gateway URL (optional, defaults to https://gateway.spraay.app)

tools.name: spraay_chat
tools.description: Send a message to 200+ AI models (GPT-4o, Claude, Llama 3, Gemini, Mistral, etc.) via the Spraay x402 Gateway. Returns the model's completion. Use spraay_models to discover available model IDs. Costs $0.005 USDC.

model.description: Model ID in OpenRouter format (e.g. 'openai/gpt-4o-mini', 'anthropic/claude-3.5-sonnet', 'meta-llama/llama-3-70b-instruct'). Use spraay_models to list all.

message.description: User message to send to the model

systemPrompt.description: Optional system prompt to set model behavior and context

tools.name: spraay_models
tools.description: List all 200+ AI models available on the Spraay x402 Gateway. Returns model IDs, providers, and context window sizes. Costs $0.001 USDC.

tools.name: spraay_batch_execute
tools.description: Execute a batch payment to up to 200 recipients in a single Base transaction via the Spraay protocol. Supports any ERC-20 token or native ETH. Returns unsigned transaction data for the sender to sign. Costs $0.01 USDC.

token.description: Token symbol (e.g. 'USDC', 'ETH', 'WETH', 'DAI') or ERC-20 contract address on Base

amounts.description: Array of amounts in token units (e.g. '100' for 100 USDC). Must match recipients length.

sender.description: Sender wallet address that will sign the transaction

tools.name: spraay_batch_estimate
tools.description: Estimate gas cost for a batch payment before executing. Returns estimated gas in wei and USD equivalent. Costs $0.001 USDC.

tools.name: spraay_swap_quote
tools.description: Get a swap quote from Uniswap V3 on Base. Returns expected output amount, price impact, and route details. Use spraay_swap_tokens to see available tokens. Costs $0.002 USDC.

tokenIn.description: Input token symbol (e.g. 'USDC', 'WETH', 'DAI') or contract address

tokenOut.description: Output token symbol (e.g. 'WETH', 'USDC') or contract address

amountIn.description: Amount to swap in human-readable units (e.g. '1000' for 1000 USDC)

tools.name: spraay_swap_tokens
tools.description: List all tokens available for swapping on Spraay via Uniswap V3 on Base. Returns symbols, addresses, and decimals. Costs $0.001 USDC.

tools.name: spraay_swap_execute
tools.description: Execute a token swap via Uniswap V3 on Base. Returns unsigned transaction data for the caller to sign and broadcast. Get a quote first with spraay_swap_quote. Costs $0.01 USDC.

tokenIn.description: Input token symbol (e.g. 'USDC') or contract address

tokenOut.description: Output token symbol (e.g. 'WETH') or contract address

amountIn.description: Amount to swap in human-readable units

tools.name: spraay_oracle_prices
tools.description: Get real-time on-chain token prices with confidence scores from Uniswap V3 QuoterV2 on Base. Returns USD prices for ETH, WETH, cbBTC, USDT, DAI, EURC, and more. Costs $0.003 USDC.

tokens.description: Comma-separated token symbols (e.g. 'ETH,cbBTC,USDT'). Omit to get all supported token prices.

tools.name: spraay_oracle_gas
tools.description: Get current gas prices on Base in gwei. Returns base fee, priority fee, and estimated transaction costs. Costs $0.001 USDC.

tools.name: spraay_oracle_fx
tools.description: Get stablecoin exchange rates with depeg detection. Returns cross-rates between USDC, USDT, DAI, and EURC. Costs $0.002 USDC.

base.description: Base stablecoin for rate calculation (default: 'USDC'). Options: USDC, USDT, DAI, EURC

tools.name: spraay_bridge_quote
tools.description: Get a cross-chain bridge quote via LI.FI aggregator. Supports Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum, Polygon, BNB Chain, Avalanche, Optimism, and more. Returns estimated output, fees, and execution time. Costs $0.005 USDC.

amount.description: Amount in smallest units (e.g. '1000000' for 1 USDC with 6 decimals)

fromAddress.description: Sender wallet address on source chain

tools.name: spraay_bridge_chains
tools.description: List all chains supported by the Spraay bridge aggregator (LI.FI). Returns chain names, IDs, and supported tokens. Costs $0.001 USDC.

tools.name: spraay_payroll_execute
tools.description: Execute a payroll batch payment via Spraay V2 contract on Base. Pay up to 200 employees in a single transaction with any stablecoin. Returns unsigned transaction data. Costs $0.02 USDC.

amount.description: Payment amount in token units (e.g. '2500' for $2500)

tools.name: spraay_payroll_estimate
tools.description: Estimate gas and fees for a payroll batch before executing. Returns estimated gas in wei and USD. Costs $0.002 USDC.

tools.name: spraay_payroll_tokens
tools.description: List all stablecoins supported for payroll on Base. Returns symbols, addresses, and decimals. Costs $0.001 USDC.

tools.name: spraay_invoice_create
tools.description: Create a payment invoice with a pre-encoded ERC-20 transfer transaction. Supports USDC, USDT, DAI, EURC, WETH on Base. Data persists in Supabase. Returns invoice ID, payment instructions, and unsigned tx. Costs $0.005 USDC.

amount.description: Invoice amount in human-readable units (e.g. '1500.00' for $1500)

recipient.description: Payer address — omit for open invoice (anyone can pay)

tools.name: spraay_invoice_list
tools.description: List invoices by creator or payer address with optional status filter. Data persists in Supabase. Costs $0.002 USDC.

address.description: Creator or payer address to filter by (e.g. '0xYourAddress')

tools.name: spraay_invoice_get
tools.description: Look up a specific invoice by ID. Returns full invoice details, on-chain balance check, and payment status. Data persists in Supabase. Costs $0.001 USDC.

tools.name: spraay_analytics_wallet
tools.description: Get a comprehensive wallet profile including ETH + token balances, wallet age, entity classification, and portfolio breakdown on Base. Costs $0.005 USDC.

tools.name: spraay_analytics_txhistory
tools.description: Get decoded transaction history for any address on Base. Returns transaction types, values, timestamps, and decoded method calls. Costs $0.003 USDC.

address.description: Wallet address to get history for

tools.name: spraay_escrow_create
tools.description: Create a conditional escrow with optional milestones, arbiter, and expiry on Base. Funds are held until release conditions are met. Data persists in Supabase. Returns escrow ID and next-step actions. Costs $0.008 USDC.

depositor.description: Depositor/client address who will fund the escrow

beneficiary.description: Beneficiary/freelancer address who receives funds on release

arbiter.description: Optional third-party arbiter who can release or cancel

tools.name: spraay_escrow_list
tools.description: List escrows by address (depositor, beneficiary, or arbiter) with optional status filter. Data persists in Supabase. Costs $0.002 USDC.

address.description: Address to list escrows for (depositor, beneficiary, or arbiter)

tools.name: spraay_escrow_get
tools.description: Get full escrow details including status, participants, conditions, balance check, and timestamps by ID. Data persists in Supabase. Costs $0.001 USDC.

tools.name: spraay_escrow_fund
tools.description: Mark an escrow as funded. Changes status from 'created' to 'funded'. Only works on unfunded, non-expired escrows. Data persists in Supabase. Costs $0.002 USDC.

tools.name: spraay_escrow_release
tools.description: Release escrow funds to the beneficiary. Returns an unsigned ERC-20 transfer transaction for the depositor to sign. Only depositor or arbiter can release. Data persists in Supabase. Costs $0.005 USDC.

caller.description: Caller address — must be depositor or arbiter

tools.name: spraay_escrow_cancel
tools.description: Cancel an escrow. Depositor can cancel unfunded escrows; depositor or arbiter can cancel funded ones. Data persists in Supabase. Costs $0.002 USDC.

caller.description: Caller address — must be depositor (or arbiter for funded escrows)

tools.name: spraay_classify_address
tools.description: AI-powered wallet classification with risk scoring. Analyzes on-chain activity to classify addresses as whale, retail, MEV bot, exchange, bridge, or contract. Returns risk score, classification, confidence, and behavioral signals. Costs $0.008 USDC.

tools.name: spraay_classify_tx
tools.description: AI-powered transaction classification with risk scoring. Decodes, categorizes, and analyzes any Base transaction. Returns type (swap, transfer, contract call, etc.), risk level, and decoded parameters. Costs $0.008 USDC.

tools.name: spraay_explain_contract
tools.description: AI-powered smart contract analysis. Explains what a verified contract does, lists its functions, identifies patterns (ERC-20, ERC-721, etc.), and flags security properties. Costs $0.01 USDC.

address.description: Contract address to analyze on Base (e.g. '0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913' for USDC)

tools.name: spraay_summarize
tools.description: AI intelligence briefing for any wallet address or transaction hash. Returns structured risk assessment, entity classification, activity summary, and actionable insights. Costs $0.008 USDC.

target.description: Address (0x..., 40 hex chars) or transaction hash (0x..., 64 hex chars) to summarize

tools.name: spraay_notify_email
tools.description: Send an email notification via AgentMail for payment confirmations, alerts, receipts, or general communication. Supports subject, CC, and reply-to. Costs $0.003 USDC.

body.description: Email body content (plain text or HTML)

tools.name: spraay_notify_sms
tools.description: Send an SMS notification for payment alerts (simulated — Twilio integration coming). Requires E.164 phone format. Costs $0.005 USDC.

tools.name: spraay_notify_status
tools.description: Check delivery status of a previously sent email or SMS notification by notification ID. Costs $0.001 USDC.

id.description: Notification ID returned from spraay_notify_email or spraay_notify_sms (e.g. 'ntf_abc123')

tools.name: spraay_webhook_register
tools.description: Register a webhook endpoint to receive real-time POST events for payments, escrows, swaps, invoices, and more. Returns webhook ID and HMAC secret for signature verification. Data persists in Supabase. Costs $0.003 USDC.

url.description: Webhook URL to receive POST events (e.g. 'https://yourapp.com/webhook')

tools.name: spraay_webhook_test
tools.description: Send a test ping event to a registered webhook to verify delivery and signature validation. Data persists in Supabase. Costs $0.002 USDC.

tools.name: spraay_webhook_list
tools.description: List all registered webhooks with their status, subscribed events, and delivery stats. Data persists in Supabase. Costs $0.001 USDC.

tools.name: spraay_webhook_delete
tools.description: Delete a registered webhook by ID. Removes it permanently from Supabase. Costs $0.001 USDC.

tools.name: spraay_xmtp_send
tools.description: Send an encrypted XMTP message to any Ethereum address on the XMTP production network. Messages are end-to-end encrypted. Costs $0.003 USDC.

to.description: Recipient Ethereum address (must have XMTP enabled)

tools.name: spraay_xmtp_inbox
tools.description: Read XMTP inbox messages for an Ethereum address. Returns decrypted messages from the production XMTP network. Costs $0.002 USDC.

address.description: Ethereum address to check inbox for

tools.name: spraay_rpc_call
tools.description: Make a premium multi-chain JSON-RPC call via Alchemy (EVM) or Helius (Solana). Supports Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum, Polygon, BNB Chain, Avalanche, and Solana. Costs $0.001 USDC.

tools.name: spraay_rpc_chains
tools.description: List all chains supported by the Spraay RPC proxy and their allowed JSON-RPC methods. Costs $0.001 USDC.

tools.name: spraay_storage_pin
tools.description: Pin content to IPFS via Pinata for permanent decentralized storage. Returns CID (content identifier) for retrieval. Supports text, JSON, and base64 data. Costs $0.005 USDC.

data.description: Content to pin — JSON string, plain text, or base64-encoded binary

tools.name: spraay_storage_get
tools.description: Retrieve previously pinned content from IPFS/Arweave by CID. Returns the stored data. Costs $0.002 USDC.

tools.name: spraay_storage_status
tools.description: Check the pin status of a storage request by pin ID. Returns pinning progress and confirmation. Costs $0.001 USDC.

tools.name: spraay_cron_create
tools.description: Create a scheduled job for recurring payments, DCA strategies, reminders, or any gateway action. Supports standard 5-part cron expressions. Data persists in Supabase. Costs $0.005 USDC.

schedule.description: Cron expression (e.g. '0 9 * * 1' for every Monday at 9am)

payload.description: Payload for the scheduled action (same format as the action's direct API call)

maxRuns.description: Max executions before auto-cancel (omit for unlimited)

tools.name: spraay_cron_list
tools.description: List all scheduled jobs with optional status and action filters. Data persists in Supabase. Costs $0.001 USDC.

tools.name: spraay_cron_cancel
tools.description: Cancel a scheduled job by ID. Stops future executions. Data persists in Supabase. Costs $0.001 USDC.

tools.name: spraay_logs_ingest
tools.description: Ingest structured logs for debugging and monitoring agent workflows. Accepts up to 100 entries per batch. Data persists in Supabase. Costs $0.001 USDC.

data.description: Additional structured data as key-value pairs

tools.name: spraay_logs_query
tools.description: Query structured logs by service, level, and time range. Returns matching log entries sorted newest first. Data persists in Supabase. Costs $0.003 USDC.

tools.name: spraay_kyc_verify
tools.description: Initiate KYC/KYB verification for compliance-gated payments. Supports individual and business verification at basic, enhanced, or full levels. Data persists in Supabase. Costs $0.05 USDC.

tools.name: spraay_kyc_status
tools.description: Check KYC verification status by record ID or wallet address. Returns verification level, check results, and expiry. Data persists in Supabase. Costs $0.005 USDC.

address.description: Ethereum address for lookup (alternative to ID)

tools.name: spraay_auth_session
tools.description: Create an authenticated session with scoped permissions and configurable TTL. Returns a session token (spr_...) for use in Authorization headers. Data persists in Supabase. Costs $0.005 USDC.

address.description: Ethereum address to create session for

permissions.description: Scoped permissions array (e.g. ['batch:execute', 'swap:execute']). Omit or pass ['*'] for all permissions.

ttlSeconds.description: Session TTL in seconds (60-86400, default: 3600 = 1 hour)

tools.name: spraay_auth_verify
tools.description: Verify a session token and check its permissions, expiry, and associated address. Data persists in Supabase. Costs $0.001 USDC.

tools.name: spraay_audit_log
tools.description: Record an immutable audit trail entry for payments, escrows, compliance actions, and other events. Data persists in Supabase. Costs $0.001 USDC.

actor.description: Actor wallet address who performed the action

tools.name: spraay_audit_query
tools.description: Query the audit trail by actor, action, resource, or time range. Returns matching entries sorted newest first. Data persists in Supabase. Costs $0.005 USDC.

tools.name: spraay_tax_calculate
tools.description: Calculate crypto tax gain/loss using FIFO method for up to 500 transactions. Returns per-event breakdown and aggregate summary with short/long-term classification. Data persists in Supabase. Costs $0.01 USDC.

transactions.description: Array of 1-500 transaction objects for tax calculation

tools.name: spraay_tax_report
tools.description: Retrieve a previously calculated tax report by ID, or list all reports. Data persists in Supabase. Costs $0.02 USDC.

reportId.description: Tax report ID from spraay_tax_calculate (e.g. 'tax_abc123'). Omit to list all reports.

tools.name: spraay_gpu_run
tools.description: Run AI model inference on GPU via Replicate. Supports image generation (flux-pro, sdxl, ideogram), video generation (wan-video, minimax-video), LLMs (llama-70b, llama-8b, mixtral), audio (whisper transcription, musicgen), and utilities (esrgan upscaling, rembg background removal). Use shortcuts like 'flux-pro' or full model IDs like 'owner/model'. Returns output directly for fast models, or a poll URL for longer jobs. Costs $0.05 USDC.

model.description: Model shortcut (flux-pro, sdxl, llama-70b, whisper, esrgan, etc.) or full Replicate model ID (owner/model-name). Use spraay_gpu_models to list all shortcuts.

input.description: Model-specific input parameters. Image models: { prompt: '...' }. LLMs: { prompt: '...' }. Whisper: { audio: 'https://...' }. ESRGAN: { image: 'https://...' }.

version.description: Specific model version hash (optional — not needed for official models)

webhook.description: Webhook URL for async result delivery (optional)

tools.name: spraay_gpu_status
tools.description: Check the status of a GPU prediction by ID. Use this to poll for results on longer-running jobs like video generation or large model inference. Returns output when complete. Costs $0.002 USDC.

tools.name: spraay_gpu_models
tools.description: List all available GPU model shortcuts grouped by category (image, video, LLM, audio, utility). Shows shortcut names, full Replicate model IDs, and descriptions. You can also use any Replicate model by its full ID. FREE — no USDC cost.

tools.name: spraay_search_web
tools.description: Search the web and get clean, LLM-ready results via Tavily. Returns extracted content (not just links), plus an AI-generated answer. Supports basic and advanced search depth, domain filtering, and topic focus (general, news, finance). Costs $0.01 USDC.

query.description: Search query (e.g. 'latest Base ecosystem developments', 'x402 protocol explained')

search_depth.description: Search depth: 'basic' (fast, default) or 'advanced' (deeper extraction, better results)

max_results.description: Number of results to return (default: 5, max: 20)

include_domains.description: Only include results from these domains (e.g. ['docs.base.org', 'ethereum.org'])

tools.name: spraay_search_extract
tools.description: Extract clean, structured content from specific URLs — perfect for RAG pipelines. Returns the full text content of each page, ready for LLM consumption. Up to 5 URLs per request. Costs $0.015 USDC.

urls.description: Array of 1-5 URLs to extract content from (e.g. ['https://docs.base.org/overview'])

tools.name: spraay_search_qna
tools.description: Ask a question and get a direct, synthesized answer with cited sources. Searches the web, extracts relevant content, and generates a comprehensive answer. Great for research and fact-checking. Costs $0.02 USDC.

query.description: Natural language question (e.g. 'What is x402 protocol and how does it work?')

tools.name: spraay_prices
tools.description: Get live on-chain token prices on Base from Uniswap V3 pools. Returns USD prices with timestamps. Costs $0.002 USDC.

token.description: Specific token symbol (e.g. 'WETH', 'cbBTC'). Omit to get all supported token prices.

tools.name: spraay_balances
tools.description: Get ETH + ERC-20 token balances for any wallet on Base. Returns formatted balances with USD values where available. Costs $0.002 USDC.

tokens.description: Comma-separated custom ERC-20 contract addresses to include

showAll.description: Set to 'true' to include zero balances

tools.name: spraay_resolve
tools.description: Resolve ENS names (.eth) and Basenames (.base.eth) to wallet addresses, or perform reverse lookup from address to name. Costs $0.001 USDC.

name.description: ENS name (e.g. 'vitalik.eth'), Basename (e.g. 'satoshi.base.eth'), or address for reverse lookup (e.g. '0xd8dA...')
